name: Python API Contract Governance Toolkit
description: Build a production-ready Python API contract governance toolkit from the uv monorepo template. The toolkit makes Python/Pydantic/FastAPI API contracts explicit, reviewable, drift-checked, diffable, target-aware, and reportable.

userStories.title: Expand Contract Registry Authoring
userStories.description: As an API maintainer, I want ContractRegistry to define models, endpoints, security, responses, examples, and targets so that API contracts are managed from one clear authoring surface.
acceptanceCriteria: ContractRegistry supports registering Pydantic models by stable schema name
ContractRegistry supports declaring standard error responses
ContractRegistry supports declaring examples for request and response bodies
ContractRegistry supports assigning endpoints to one or more targets
Public exports are updated for new contract authoring types

userStories.title: Add Response and Error Contract Model
userStories.description: As an API maintainer, I want response contracts to include status codes, body schemas, and examples so that OpenAPI output reflects real API behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a response contract type that can represent status code, description, model reference, content type, and examples
Support success responses and error responses separately
Keep simple response_model="User" route declarations supported
Add explicit responses={...} or equivalent for multi-status operations
OpenAPI emit includes all declared response statuses
Validation reports missing response model references

userStories.title: Add Security Scheme Management
userStories.description: As an API maintainer, I want security schemes to be declared in the registry so that authentication requirements are explicit and validated.
acceptanceCriteria: Add registry API for bearer, apiKey, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and mutualTLS schemes
Endpoints can reference registered security scheme names
OpenAPI emit includes operation-level security requirements
Validation reports references to unknown security schemes
Example app includes a representative bearer auth scheme

userStories.title: Strengthen Contract Validation Policies
userStories.description: As an API reviewer, I want validation policies to catch contract quality issues before code reaches CI so that contracts remain consistent and reviewable.
acceptanceCriteria: ValidationIssue includes severity, code, location, and detail
Validation detects missing request and response model references
Validation detects missing security scheme references
Validation detects missing required error responses for configured targets
Validation detects public target leakage of internal-only models or endpoints
CLI validate can load both JSON contract files and module:attr registry references

userStories.title: Deterministic OpenAPI Artifact Emission
userStories.description: As a release engineer, I want deterministic OpenAPI artifacts so that generated contract diffs are stable and reviewable.
acceptanceCriteria: emit_openapi() emits stable key ordering for paths, methods, schemas, responses, security schemes, and tags
CLI emit-openapi accepts module:attr registry references in addition to serialized contract JSON
CLI output is deterministic across repeated runs
OpenAPI output includes a version hash or equivalent metadata sidecar
Generated artifacts contain only contract-derived data, not incidental runtime state
Tests verify repeated emission produces identical JSON

userStories.title: Add Artifact Freshness Check
userStories.description: As a CI maintainer, I want to fail stale OpenAPI artifacts so that generated files cannot drift from the managed contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Command compares managed contract OpenAPI output with an existing artifact file
Command exits non-zero when the artifact is stale
Command supports JSON and human-readable output
Command reports the artifact path and a concise drift summary
README documents the recommended contracts/<api>/openapi.json artifact layout

userStories.title: Strengthen Breaking Diff Classifier
userStories.description: As an API reviewer, I want contract diffs to classify breaking changes accurately so that unsafe API changes are blocked before release.
acceptanceCriteria: Diff detects required request field additions
Diff detects response field type narrowing
Diff detects nullable to non-nullable changes
Diff output separates breaking and non-breaking changes
--fail-on-breaking exits non-zero only for breaking changes

userStories.title: Normalize FastAPI Drift Comparison
userStories.description: As a FastAPI maintainer, I want drift checks to ignore framework noise while catching meaningful contract mismatches so that CI failures are trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Drift comparison normalizes FastAPI automatic validation responses such as 422
Drift comparison detects runtime routes missing from the contract
Drift comparison detects contract routes missing from runtime OpenAPI
Drift comparison detects operation ID mismatch
Drift comparison detects request schema mismatch
Drift comparison detects response schema mismatch
Drift comparison detects status code mismatch for managed statuses
CLI drift supports text, JSON, and Markdown output modes

userStories.title: Add Public/Admin/Internal Target Split
userStories.description: As a platform maintainer, I want a single registry to emit public, admin, and internal OpenAPI documents so that each audience receives only the API surface intended for it.
acceptanceCriteria: Add target declaration API to ContractRegistry
Endpoints can be assigned to one or more targets
Models can be marked public, admin, internal, or shared
OpenAPI emit supports --target public, --target admin, and --target internal
Target-specific artifacts include only reachable schemas
Validation fails when public targets reference internal-only schemas
Tests verify public output excludes admin/internal endpoints
Tests verify internal output can include internal schemas

userStories.title: Add Contract Review Report
userStories.description: As a pull request reviewer, I want a Markdown and JSON contract review report so that API changes can be reviewed without reading raw OpenAPI JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Review combines diff, drift, validation, and artifact freshness checks
Review emits JSON output for automation
Review emits Markdown output for PR comments
Review includes recommendation: APPROVE, COMMENT, or REQUEST_CHANGES
Tests cover report output for clean and failing cases

userStories.title: Add Pytest Integration Helpers
userStories.description: As a Python service developer, I want pytest helpers so that contract validation and drift checks can be added to existing projects with minimal boilerplate.
acceptanceCriteria: Helpers accept module references and direct objects
Example app includes a pytest contract gate using helpers

userStories.title: Improve Example API as Adoption Reference
userStories.description: As a new adopter, I want the example app to demonstrate realistic API governance patterns so that I can copy the structure into my own service.
acceptanceCriteria: Example app keeps DTOs in models.py
Example app keeps registry setup in contracts.py
Example app keeps route implementation in main.py
Example app demonstrates security scheme registration
Example app demonstrates error response registration
Example app demonstrates drift command in README
Example app tests cover registry, FastAPI route, and drift behavior

userStories.title: Add CI and Migration Documentation
userStories.description: As an adopting team, I want clear CI and migration guidance so that I can introduce the toolkit without rewriting my whole API.
acceptanceCriteria: README includes existing FastAPI project migration steps
README explains which files are source of truth and which are generated artifacts
README explains how to handle intentional breaking changes
README explains how to suppress or resolve known framework drift
README includes recommended folder layout for contracts/

userStories.title: Add Machine-Readable Contract Snapshots
userStories.description: As a release engineer, I want serialized contract snapshots so that releases can compare contract versions without importing application code.
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot serializes a registry or contract object to deterministic contract.json
Snapshot can be used as input to validate, diff, emit-openapi, and review
Snapshot output is stable across repeated runs
Tests verify module-based registry and JSON snapshot produce equivalent OpenAPI

userStories.title: Define Adapter Extension Interface
userStories.description: As a toolkit maintainer, I want a clean adapter interface so that future frameworks can be supported without coupling core contracts to FastAPI.
acceptanceCriteria: Define adapter protocol for runtime OpenAPI extraction
Drift command uses adapter abstraction internally
Core interface-contracts package does not import FastAPI
README lists future adapter candidates: Litestar, Django Ninja, Flask
